extensionDescription.message: Replaces the BOOK☆WALKER viewer's built-in marker with markers, notes and an LLM chat the extension owns.

optionsLoadFailedHint.message: The form stays hidden until the read succeeds, so it cannot overwrite what you already saved.

optionsStorageNote.message: Markers live in the store you pick here only. The two never sync, and switching does not move them. This extension never writes back to your BOOK☆WALKER account.

optionsSecretsLocalNote.message: Keys stay on this computer and are never synced to your other devices.

optionsPermissionNotice.message: Saving asks for permission to these origins: $origins$

optionsPermissionDenied.message: Not saved: you denied access to $origins$. Save again and allow it, or pick a provider that needs no extra permission.

optionsSaved.message: Saved. It takes effect right away.

optionsSavedLlmIncomplete.message: Saved. The LLM is not configured yet.

optionsNotSavedFields.message: Not saved (see the field problems above)

providerModelsDenied.message: You denied access to $origins$, so “$label$” was not queried. Press “Load model list” again and allow it, or type the model name yourself.

providerModelsFailed.message: Could not fetch the model list for “$label$”. Check the required fields and your connection, or type the model name yourself.

providerUnknownSelected.message: The selected provider “$id$” does not exist in this version. Pick another.

promptsIntro.message: These buttons appear above the chatbot in the side panel. Placeholders:

promptPresetTranslateTemplate.message:
Translate this Japanese passage from “{{bookTitle}}” into English, keeping the tone of the original:

{{text}}

promptPresetGrammarTemplate.message:
Explain the grammar of this Japanese passage, breaking down the particles and verb forms sentence by sentence:

{{text}}

promptPresetReadingTemplate.message:
Give the reading of every kanji in this Japanese passage, using the {漢字|かんじ} format:

{{text}}

markerEmptyHint.message: Select text in the viewer, or tap an existing marker.

markerMemoHint.message: Notes take readings as {漢字|かんじ}; they render as ruby once you leave the box.

markerNotFound.message: No such marker; it may have been deleted.

markerDeletedNeedsReload.message: Marker deleted. The highlight goes away after you reload the viewer.

chatPickMarker.message: Pick a marker to ask about it.

chatNotStored.message: The conversation is not stored; it goes when you close the panel or switch passages.

chatPortDisconnected.message: The connection dropped and the reply was cut off. Send it again.

viewerSelectionFailed.message: Could not read the selected text. Select it again.

errorModelRequestFailed.message: The model request failed. Check the API key, model id and endpoint on the settings page.

errorMarkerGone.message: This marker no longer exists, so the conversation cannot continue.

errorModelEmptyReply.message: The model returned nothing. Rephrase, or use another model.

errorBookContextMissing.message: No information for this book, so the marker cannot be created. Reload the viewer page.

errorHostPermissionMissing.message: No host permission for $label$ ($origins$). Save this provider again on the settings page.

errorNotionUnreachable.message: Could not reach Notion. Check your connection.

errorNotionRowNotOurs.message: This Notion row has no '$prop$' property, so this extension did not create it.

errorNotionValueUnknown.message: Notion page $id$ has an unrecognised '$prop$' value: '$value$'.

llmFieldModelHelp.message: Use “Load model list”, or type the model id directly.

llmFieldReasoningHelp.message: Leave empty to let the model decide. Only reasoning models take any notice.

llmKeyHelpLocalOnly.message: Stays on this computer; never uploaded.

llmKeyHelpGemini.message: Get one from Google AI Studio. Stays on this computer.

notionPatHelp.message: Share the target database with this integration. Notion gets noticeably slower once you have many markers.
